battle.name: 維京人入侵法蘭克王國
battle.theater: 索姆河下游聖瓦萊里修道院
battle.brief: 795年北歐船隊越過北海，掃掠亞基坦海岸後北上，縱火焚毀彭蒂尤的聖瓦萊里修道院，開法蘭克本土遭襲之先；799至800年以船隊封鎖潮汐島堡壘約七個月，迫使守方付出白銀贖金。卡面的羅馬弩砲是共和末期一發一矢的扭力投射機，西歐早已失傳，本役攻守雙方皆無攻城機械，勝負全押在船隊與封鎖。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 795年之後的北歐船隊所面對的，不是一個統一的敵國，而是加洛林帝國崩解後的三個法蘭克王國，加上他們自己內部的聯盟。西部法蘭克王國最為脆弱：843年《普呂姆條約》把帝國分給三子，西部份最靠近大西洋與北海航線，是北歐船隊首當其衝的目標；洛林與中法蘭克兩區退居內陸，直到九世紀末才捲入大規模襲擊。維京一方並非單一民族軍隊，而是以丹麥人為主、挪威與瑞典船隊為輔的臨時聯盟，戰時由各部首領率船隊入夥，戰後解散返鄉；丹麥與法蘭克之間原有一條以金錢與傳教為名的脆弱和平線，795年後這條線被反覆試探。第三方同時在場：北海沿岸的弗里西亞人與薩克森人既是法蘭克邊臣，也是北歐的接應者；更南下，阿拉曼人與薩拉森勢力把法蘭克的注意力分散到東南；法蘭克境內的維京人逐步由散兵變為定居者，日後成為諾曼底的核心人口。整體而言，795年開啟的不是一場一次性戰役，而是一段長達一百一十六年、跨越四代王朝的連續衝突。
countriesEn: What the northern fleets faced after 795 was not a single unified enemy state but the three Frankish kingdoms left behind by the break-up of the Carolingian empire, together with alliances of their own making. West Francia was the most exposed: the Treaty of Prüm in 843 divided the empire among three sons, and the western share, lying closest to the Atlantic and North Sea routes, became the first target of the northern fleets; Lorraine and Middle Francia lay further inland and were not drawn into large-scale raids until the late ninth century. The Viking side was not a single national army either, but a temporary coalition mainly Danish, with Norwegian and Swedish contingents, mustered by the chieftains of each fleet for the season and dissolved again once the season was over. The line between Denmark and the Franks had rested on a fragile arrangement of money and missions, and after 795 that line was tested again and again. Third parties were present throughout: the Frisians and Saxons of the North Sea coasts were both Frankish subjects and the Northmen's suppliers; further south, Alamanni and Saracen forces pulled Frankish attention towards the south-east; and the Vikings inside the kingdom gradually turned from scattered raiders into settlers who would become the core population of Normandy. What began in 795 was therefore not a one-off campaign but a continuous conflict lasting a hundred and sixteen years and spanning four generations of dynasty.
people: 決定這場衝突走向的是加洛林王朝的查理曼大帝，但他大部分時間並不在前線。795年他正忙於薩克森戰爭與易北河一線的斯拉夫戰事，他把北海與大西洋沿岸的防衛交給地方伯爵與宮廷伯爵，這種分散授權正是海岸線形同無防的原因。記錄最生動的一段來自約克的阿爾昆：他在給聖瓦萊里修士的信中描述維京人如何以船隊封住潮汐島、縱火燒掉修道院、又圍困七個月，最後由當地總管烏爾費爾出面，以六百磅白銀贖金換得守軍與修士撤出。島上的主教阿爾比努斯在圍城前已逃往內陸，令這座要塞失去主教的權威與精神樞紐。九年後的索姆河海戰中，與法蘭克艦隊並肩作戰的是薩克森首領威杜金，以及查理曼的孫子赫魯德蘭。進入九世紀，名字換成奧多（巴黎伯爵）、阿博（聖日耳曼德佩爾修士，巴黎圍城計策的記錄者）與丹麥王古茲林；最後是911年克萊條約中接下魯昂等地的北方首領羅洛。值得注意的是，同一批武裝在806年旺相港與法蘭克人並肩對付薩拉森艦隊，敵我之間的界線並不像編年史寫的那樣清楚。
peopleEn: The man who shaped this conflict was Charlemagne, but he was rarely on the spot. In 795 he was absorbed in the Saxon war and in the fighting along the Elbe, and he left the defence of the Atlantic and North Sea coasts to the counts of the shires and the counts of the palace, a dispersal of authority that is precisely why the coast line was in practice undefended. The most vivid record comes from Alcuin of York: in his letter to the monks of Saint-Valery he described how the Vikings sealed the tidal island with their ships, burned the abbey, and held the place for some seven months, until the local reeve Ulfer came forward and secured the withdrawal of the garrison and the monks by a ransom of six hundred pounds of silver. The bishop of the place, Albinus, had already fled inland before the siege, and the fortress lost its spiritual authority along with him. At the naval battle on the Somme nine years later the Frankish fleet fought shoulder to shoulder with the Saxon leader Widukind and with Charlemagne's grandson Hruodland. Through the ninth century the names change: Odo, count of Paris; Abbo of Saint-Germain-des-Prés, who recorded the stratagem that saved besieged Paris; and Gozlin, king of Denmark; and finally Rollo, the northern leader who took Rouen and its neighbourhood in the treaty of Clichy of 911. It is worth noticing that the same armed men fought alongside the Franks against a Saracen fleet at Wissant in 806: the line between friend and enemy was never as clean as the annalists drew it.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是共和末期到帝制初期的扭力投射機：以人力把木製或青銅框架上的弩弦扭緊儲力，一次只發一矢，箭身帶銅或鐵的三棱錐頭，長約半公尺有餘、質量以公斤計，有效射程常被估在二百至三百公尺之間，發完須重新上弦，故壓得住一段城牆卻打不出連續火力幕。關鍵是時差：795年距羅馬弩砲的鼎盛期已過八個半世紀，拉丁西方的扭力投射機在帝國晚期即告廢棄，同時期的東地中海仍在用繩索式投石機守城，而西歐要到十一、十二世紀才重新出現攻城機械；八世紀末的法蘭克軍隊手上沒有任何可攜帶的攻城砲，只有雲梯、撞柱、壕溝與坑道。北方船隊同樣沒有攻城機械，卻有一件羅馬人沒有的東西：船。登岸靠小艇，縱火靠攜帶的引火物與縱火船的技術，摧毀的是「可燒的東西」而不是「可攻的城牆」，所以修道院、倉房與漁村在劫掠中特別脆弱。真正的攻城技術在這場戰爭裡轉到了別處：法蘭克人一邊在沿海修築望樓與烽火台，一邊在800年前後的《莊園法令》與致沿海伯爵的訓令中要求造艦並維持船塢；北歐人的對應裝備則是圓盾與丹麥斧結成的盾牆，配上投槍、斧與短劍，專門用來迎擊法蘭克重騎兵，而法蘭克人自810年起才開始嘗試以全速衝撞木柵的打法反制盾牆。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a torsion engine of the late Republic and the early Empire: men twisted the bowstring of a wooden or bronze frame until the stored energy was high, and the machine loosed a single bolt at a time, an arrow with a copper or iron three-edged head, a little over half a metre long and weighing on the order of a kilogram, with an effective range commonly estimated at two hundred to three hundred metres. After each shot the string had to be wound again, so it could pin down a stretch of wall but never lay down a curtain of fire. The decisive point is the gap in time: 795 was eight and a half centuries past the heyday of the Roman bolt-thrower. Torsion artillery had already been abandoned in the Latin West in late antiquity, the eastern Mediterranean was still defending Constantinople with traction stone-throwers, and western Europe would not see siege engines again until the eleventh and twelfth centuries. The late eighth-century Frankish army had no portable artillery of any kind, only ladders, rams, ditches and mines. The northern fleets had no siege engines either, but they had one thing the Romans did not: the ship. Landing was made in small boats, fire was set with carried kindling and with the technique of fire-ships, and what was destroyed was the burnable rather than the defensible, which is why abbeys, storehouses and fishing villages were so fragile under a raid. The real siegecraft of this war lay elsewhere: the Franks built watchtowers and beacon stations along the coast, and in the Capitulare de villis and in the instructions to the coastal counts around 800 they ordered ships to be built and ship-sheds to be kept; the Northmen answered with the shield wall of round shields and Danish axes, backed by throwing spears, axes and short swords, made specifically to meet the Frankish heavy cavalry, which from 810 onwards the Franks tried to break by charging wooden palisades at full speed.
tactics: 北歐船隊的戰法由海路決定。抵近海岸後先在河口與沙洲後泊船，派人偵察灘頭與守軍人數，再以小艇分批登陸；登岸時前列盾牆，斧手破柵，矛手壓住通道，縱火者隨後放火破壞物資，得手即撤回船上，絕不讓法蘭克騎兵有追上來的機會。799至800年的聖瓦萊里之圍顯示另一種節奏：不攻城，只封航道，讓潮汐島與陸地隔絕，再以固定的石牆消耗對方，最後收錢了事。從865年起，北歐人更把戰爭變成駐紮：冬營紮在塞納河與易北河之間，以船隊控制河道、以步騎分營屯田，不再只是季節性的掠奪。法蘭克人一邊在制度上回應：800年後的沿海伯爵訓令、遍布的望樓與烽火台、以及重新組建的海軍；808年索姆河口一役，法蘭克與薩克森聯軍利用丹麥船隊擱淺與陣形混亂的機會焚毀其船；811年法蘭克與布魯日民兵解聖貝爾蒂之圍；806年旺相港一役更把北歐人拉到自己這邊共同對付薩拉森。另一個戰術要點在防禦方：法蘭克人守城靠石牆、高塔與弩機，靠城內的井與存糧把圍城拖成消耗戰，這是北歐人無法用火攻解決的目標。
tacticsEn: The northern method of war was dictated by the sea. A fleet approaching the coast first anchored behind the river mouths and sandbanks, sent men forward to scout the beach and count the defenders, and then landed in small parties by boat. On landing they closed the shield wall, axe-men cut the palisade, spearmen held the gap, and the fire-setters went in behind them to burn stores and gear; then they went back to the ships at once, so that Frankish cavalry would never get the chance to catch up. The siege of Saint-Valery in 799 and 800 shows a different rhythm: they did not attack, they sealed the channel and cut the tidal island off from the mainland, wore the garrison down behind its own stone wall, and took payment at the end. From 865 the northerners turned war into garrison duty as well: winter camps on the Seine and along the Elbe, ships holding the rivers, foot and horse in separate camps, no longer mere seasonal raiding. The Franks replied in institutions: the instructions to the coastal counts after 800, watchtowers and beacon fires along the shore, and a fleet rebuilt from scratch. At the mouth of the Somme in 808 the Frankish-Saxon alliance took advantage of the Danish ships grounding and of the disorder of their formation to burn them; in 811 the Franks and the men of Bruges relieved Saint-Bertin; and at Wissant in 806 the Northmen were drawn onto the Frankish side against the Saracens. The other tactical point belongs to the defence: the Franks held their towns with stone walls, high towers and missile weapons, and used the wells and the grain inside to turn a siege into a war of attrition, and that was the one target the northern fire could not solve.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。795年，法蘭克編年首次記載北歐船隊劫掠亞基坦，是北歐人襲擊法蘭克本土的開端；同一批編年自此以「Normanni」稱呼這批北來者。799至800年，聖瓦萊里島被圍七個月，贖金六百磅白銀，由法蘭克方面支付。806年8月16日，旺相港海戰，薩拉森艦隊在法蘭克與維京的聯合艦隊前敗亡，同一座小島上的聖斯德望修道院被燒。808年，丹麥人帶二百餘艘船進攻索姆河口，被赫魯德蘭與威杜金指揮的法蘭克與薩克森聯軍擊敗，焚其船。811年，丹麥人再以百二十艘上下的船隊奪取根特附近的聖貝爾蒂修道院、圍攻法蘭西伯爵的城堡，終被法蘭西人與布魯日民兵擊退，編年記其七艘船被焚。843年《普呂姆條約》分帝國；845年北歐人洗劫巴黎，巴黎伯爵奧多於楓丹涅爾擊退之。865年後的偉大異教軍在八八〇年代集結至數百艘船、兵力以萬計，876年楓丹涅爾之戰雙方皆重創；885至886年巴黎被圍至次年春天，阿博記載的伏兵藏於翻覆船殼之下的計策迫使其退去；894年魯汶之役卡林霍爾夫・阿拉福直搗其營；902年大軍解散；911年克萊條約以魯昂與貝桑一帶的封地換取羅洛改宗效忠。前後一百一十六年，北歐對法蘭克領土的襲擊從未真正停止。關於本場標作六月的月份：795年那次首度掠奪在法蘭克編年中只定年份而不記月，卡面所標的月份係按北歐船隊春夏出航、冬季返鄉的航行季所作的推定，並非史籍明載。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. In 795 the Frankish annals recorded for the first time the ravaging of Aquitaine by northern fleets, the opening of raids on Frankish soil; the same annals henceforth call the newcomers Normanni. In 799 and 800 the island of Saint-Valery was besieged for seven months and a ransom of six hundred pounds of silver was paid on the Frankish side. On 16 August 806 the Saracen fleet was destroyed at Wissant by a combined Frankish and Viking fleet, and the monastery of Saint Stephen on the same island was burned. In 808 the Danes came with more than two hundred ships against the mouth of the Somme and were beaten by the Frankish-Saxon alliance under Hruodland and Widukind, who burned the ships. In 811 the Danes returned with a fleet of some hundred and twenty ships, took the abbey of Saint-Bertin near Ghent and besieged the castle of the count of Flanders, and were finally beaten back by the Flemings and the men of Bruges; the annals record seven of their ships being burned. The Treaty of Prüm of 843 divided the empire; in 845 the Northmen sacked Paris and Odo, count of Paris, checked them at Fontenelle. After 865 the Great Heathen Army gathered by the mid-880s to several hundred ships and a host numbered in tens of thousands, and the battle of Fontenelle in 876 devastated both sides. Paris was besieged from 885 into the spring of 886, and the stratagem recorded by Abbo, with men hidden under the upturned hulls of ships, forced the besiegers away. At Leuven in 894 Arnulf of Carinthia struck straight at their camp, and in 902 the great army dissolved. In 911 the treaty of Clichy gave Rollo the fiefs of Rouen and Bessin in exchange for his conversion and his loyalty. Across a hundred and sixteen years the northern raids on Frankish soil never truly stopped.
cause: 深一層的原因有四條。第一是北歐自身的社會與經濟變化：斯堪的納維亞南部的農業定著、人口的增加以及丹麥王權的形成，使一批在夏末出航、冬季返鄉的船主把劫掠與貿易結合起來，澤西與弗里西亞的商路成了最直接的誘因。第二是法蘭克的注意力被別處吸走：795年前後，查理曼正在薩克森人與易北河對岸的斯拉夫人之間應戰，帝國在東線投入的兵力遠多於西線，沿海只留下為數不多的守備。第三是丹麥與法蘭克之間原有的緩衝失效：加洛林王朝以歲幣、傳教與條約維持北方邊界，一旦北歐首領不再接受這套安排，或者出現一位不接受提醒的丹麥王，衝突就會直接落到海上。第四是戰略生態的差距：法蘭克王國的航海傳統在六、七世紀尚存，兩百年下來已近乎斷絕，沿海不但沒有海軍，連像樣的守望與報警系統也沒有建立。北歐人因此在每次襲擊中都握有主動，而法蘭克方面的每一次反擊都必須從零開始重建能力。
causeEn: At a deeper level four causes lie behind the conflict. First, the social and economic change in the north itself: the settling of agriculture in southern Scandinavia, the growth of population and the consolidation of Danish kingship turned a body of shipowners who sailed out at the end of summer and returned home in winter into raiders who combined plunder with trade, and the routes to Jersey and Frisia were the most immediate temptation. Second, Frankish attention was drawn elsewhere: around 795 Charlemagne was engaged with the Saxons and with the Slavs across the Elbe, and the empire put far more men into the eastern front than into the western, leaving only a thin watch on the coast. Third, the existing buffer between Denmark and the Franks failed: the Carolingians had held the northern frontier with tribute, missions and treaties, and once a northern chieftain no longer accepted that arrangement, or a Danish king arose who did not take hints, the clash moved straight onto the water. Fourth was the gap in strategic ecology: the naval tradition of the Frankish kingdom, alive in the sixth and seventh centuries, had all but died out in the two hundred years since, and the coasts had neither a fleet nor, as yet, any proper system of watch and alarm. The Northmen therefore held the initiative in every raid, while each Frankish counter-stroke had to rebuild its capacity from nothing.
impact: 795年之後的襲擊，對法蘭克世界的改變比任何一場會戰都大。第一，維京人把加洛林帝國的注意力從地中海與薩克森前線拉回大西洋，帝國在八二〇年代失去了六、七世紀曾經擁有的海軍傳統，沿海防衛重新從零建起；這場戰爭造就了法蘭克第一批有系統的海岸警戒網——望樓、烽火台接力，以及《莊園法令》與沿海伯爵訓令所要求的造艦與船塢，此後成為王國抵禦丹麥與諾曼突襲的骨架。第二，它把北歐人從季節性的掠奪者變成永久定居者：先是出現在法蘭克境內的北歐人社群，然後是911年後在魯昂周圍扎根的北歐農民與武士，諾曼底公國的居民結構與法律傳統由此成形。第三，戰爭把法蘭克自身的軍事體制推向另一個方向：加洛林後期大量起用北歐傭兵，843年之後西法蘭克內戰中出現過維京人站在不同陣營作戰的情形，說明同一批武裝已能為不同主人而戰。九世紀的偉大異教軍冬營於塞納河畔，幾乎把法蘭克王國變成北歐人的第二故鄉，也迫使西法蘭克在王朝分裂、內戰與外敵之間疲於奔命。最後是教會與文化的代價：沿海修道院是這場戰爭最典型的目標，聖瓦萊里的火與贖金、聖貝爾蒂的陷落，說明戰爭直接打擊的正是西歐的文教秩序與沿海的鹽、漁業經濟。
impactEn: The raids that followed 795 changed the Frankish world more than any pitched battle. First, the Vikings pulled the attention of the Carolingian empire away from the Mediterranean and the Saxon front back towards the Atlantic, and in the 820s the empire had to rebuild its coastal defence from zero, having lost the naval tradition it had possessed in the sixth and seventh centuries. The war produced the first systematic coastal alarm system the Franks ever had, watchtowers and relay beacons and the shipbuilding and ship-sheds required by the Capitulare de villis and by the instructions to the coastal counts, and that system became the framework by which the kingdom met Danish and Norwegian raids for the next two centuries. Second, it turned the Northmen from seasonal raiders into permanent settlers: first the Scandinavian communities inside the kingdom, then the farmers and warriors who put down roots around Rouen after 911, from which the population structure and legal traditions of the duchy of Normandy grew. Third, the war pushed Frankish military organisation in another direction, with large-scale use of Scandinavian mercenaries in the later Carolingian period and Vikings fighting for different employers in the civil wars of West Francia after 843, showing that the same armed men could now serve different masters. The great army of the 880s wintering on the Seine almost made the Frankish kingdom a second homeland for the Northmen, and it kept West Francia permanently stretched between dynastic division, civil war and foreign enemies. Last was the cost to church and culture: the coastal monasteries were the standing targets of this war, and the burning of Saint-Valery, its ransom, and the fall of Saint-Bertin show that the conflict struck directly at the ecclesiastical order of the west and at the salt and fishing economy of the coast.
result: 就795年這一役而言，結果是雙面的。短期的失敗是實打實的：亞基坦海岸被掃掠，聖瓦萊里被燒、被圍，攻方在海上和城島周圍掌握主動，799至800年的圍城期間沒有任何法蘭克部隊能把守軍解救出來。短期的收復則來自制度與技術：808年的索姆河口、811年的聖貝爾蒂，是加洛林海軍重建後的第一批成果，說明以艦隊對艦隊的思路奏效；806年旺相港一役中北歐人站在法蘭克這邊，更顯示這場戰爭裡的敵我關係從來不是單純的種族界線。但整場衝突沒有軍事上的終局：從795到911，維京人始終未能被逐出法蘭克王國，只能被分期吸收，直到九二〇年代以後法蘭克王室的遠征與地方貴族的抵抗才把大規模襲擊壓下去。真正的政治結算點是911年的克萊條約——北方法蘭克王國以魯昂、貝桑一帶的封地換取羅洛改宗與效忠，北歐人的首個公國在法蘭克王國內部建立，維京人的戰爭從此轉為封建權力與王位繼承的競爭。往後兩個世紀，這批後裔在法蘭西王國的權力核心中不斷上升，1066年則把征服的旗子插上英格蘭。
resultEn: For the campaign of 795 itself the outcome cuts both ways. The immediate defeat was real: the Aquitanian coast was swept, Saint-Valery was burned and then besieged, the attackers held the initiative at sea and around the island, and no Frankish force could break the siege and relieve the garrison in 799 or 800. The immediate recovery came from institutions and technique: the Somme in 808 and Saint-Bertin in 811 were the first results of the rebuilt Carolingian fleet, and they showed that fleet against fleet was the right answer; the Northmen fighting on the Frankish side at Wissant in 806 demonstrated that the lines of this war were never simply ethnic. But the conflict as a whole had no military conclusion. From 795 to 911 the Vikings were never expelled from the Frankish kingdom; they could only be absorbed in stages, and it was only after the 920s, with royal campaigns and the resistance of the regional nobility, that large-scale raids were pushed back. The real political settlement came in 911 at Clichy, where the king of the West Franks gave Rollo the fiefs of Rouen and Bessin in exchange for his conversion and his loyalty, and the first northern duchy was founded inside the Frankish kingdom, turning Viking war into a competition over feudal power and succession. Over the two following centuries these descendants rose steadily into the core of the French royal power, and in 1066 they planted the banner of conquest in England.
